title: Pickleball Club: Character, Community, and Leadership
author: John Christian

blocks.text: The Kontagious Pickleball Club is a fun, high-impact initiative focused on community building and developing individual leadership in you, rather than on athletic competition. Our philosophy is that sport does not build character—it reveals it.
A Platform for Authentic Growth

The game is a fun, inclusive way for us to connect authentically with Gen Z students and create a genuine “home away from home” environment. The relationships formed here are real and lasting, strengthened by our intentional focus on values like integrity and honesty—American work ethics that naturally show up and take shape in the real-time moments of the game.
We are committed to developing leaders, not just great players. This is where dreamers and doers come together, in order to cultivate the Kontagious community.
Intentional Leadership

Every game serves a higher purpose: identifying and nurturing future leaders. Our approach is personal and intentional. We use the club as a space to observe and understand students on a deeper level through play.
As the saying goes, “Eagles don’t flock—you have to find them one at a time” (H. Ross Perot).

The court gives us a natural window into how you communicate, problem-solve, and show up in real time. This helps us recognize the unique potential in each participant and offer tailored mentorship that creates a direct pathway into our formal leadership programs.

The Pickleball Club is open to anyone who is interested, regardless of experience. It’s an inclusive and accessible space where students can learn, connect, and begin their journey toward becoming impactful global leaders.
Developing Global Leaders from Day One

Kontagious is uniquely positioned to support international students from the moment they arrive in the United States through to the launch of their careers. Our mission is grounded in intentional leadership development, deep mentorship, and the personal growth necessary for cultural transition and embracing the American work ethic.

Our Midweek Hiking initiative is a consistent, high-impact environment for relational mentorship. These weekly hikes offer a space to learn essential life and leadership skills that are often not addressed in the classroom. Through focused conversation, students practice crafting effective elevator pitches, learn how to say “no” with clarity, and prepare themselves for real-world challenges.

We also explore foundational values—integrity, honesty, and excellence—and discuss how to build a strong personal culture around them. This intentional approach to character formation is how we help shape participants into future industry leaders.
Unparalleled Results: Cultivating Global Leaders

Today’s marketplace seeks leaders, not just technically skilled employees. Our approach centers on developing individuals who stand out through excellent results, clear thinking, adaptability, teamwork, and a willingness to grow.

Through our intensive six-week Rare Leadership Course and ongoing specialized mentorship, we prepare students not only to be strong candidates but to become the kind of leaders companies seek to invest in.
Lasting Legacy & Vision

The impact of this focused mentorship is measurable. While our broader outreach connects with more than 2,000 students annually, our career readiness programs consistently deliver exceptional results: **95% of participants secure full-time employment upon graduation.**

But our vision extends beyond professional success. Echoing the words of industrialist Andrew Carnegie—“To die rich is to die disgraced”—Kontagious is committed to instilling values that encourage students to use their skills, influence, and success to build lives of integrity, excellence, and lasting impact.

title: Alumni Farewell Celebration: A Bittersweet Goodbye
author: John Christian

blocks.text: We gathered on June 13th for a special farewell dinner to celebrate three amazing alumni: Rohit, Juhi, and Sourab. As they embark on a new adventure away from Silicon Valley, it was a wonderful opportunity to honor their friendships and reflect on their time here.

blocks.caption: Kindness, love, and smiles are the foundation of our community, and it shows in every face!

blocks.text: The evening was filled with fantastic shared experiences, laughter, and camaraderie. It was particularly moving to hear them recount their first moments meeting each other and their initial arrival in the U.S., a journey that for many, began with tears of uncertainty. These shared memories brought a few more tears, this time of gratitude and heartfelt connection, as they shared how Kontagious became a true family for them.

blocks.caption: A true alumni family, building long-lasting friendships and relationships!

blocks.text: Each alum spoke movingly about how the Kontagious experience profoundly impacted their lives and lifestyles. They expressed immense gratitude for the values imparted, especially as they begin their careers in the U.S.

It was truly great to connect with Rohit, Juhi, and Sourab, and we wished them all the very best with smiles and love for the years to come! Kontagious is more than just a community; it's a foundation that shapes lives.

title: An Unforgettable Adventure in the Redwoods!
author: John Christian

blocks.text: On May 31st, 2025, a spirited group of 33 early birds from San Jose kicked off an incredible day at Nisene Marks State Park in Santa Cruz! We hit the trails by 7:45 AM, ready for an amazing journey through the towering redwoods.

blocks.caption: All smiles and ready to roll! Kicking off our Aptos hike at 7:45 AM, geared up for a beautiful walk!

blocks.text: This wasn't just any walk; it was one of the best! The forest was absolutely stunning, with a peaceful watershed on one side and majestic trees reaching for the sky on the other. Beyond the breathtaking scenery, it was a fantastic opportunity for laughter, connection, and a lot of networking. Everyone enjoyed getting to know each other, making this hike truly special.

blocks.caption: Taking a well-deserved break mid-hike! Enjoying the moment on this bridge that connects two mountains and brings so much joy

blocks.text: Even with the early start from San Jose, the fun continued after our adventure. We recharged with a delicious burger lunch, full of good company and great conversation.

blocks.caption: Resting up after a long, beautiful walk! Time for some much-deserved lunch, more connecting, and plenty of laughs. Still smiling!

blocks.text: This memorable trip was packed with fun, forging many long-lasting friendships and creating cherished memories. We truly enjoyed every moment!

title: Pitching Tents: Camping at Reinhardt Redwoods!
author: John Christian

blocks.text: What an amazing adventure we had! 27 of us embarked on an incredible overnight camping trip to Reinhardt Redwood Park from June 14th & 15th. It was truly a unique experience from start to finish.

blocks.caption: Learning how to pitch tents and enjoying every bit of the fun working together!

blocks.text: The fun began with everyone pitching their own tents – quite a feat for some! We had a blast hiking through the majestic redwoods, enjoying the fresh air and stunning scenery. As evening settled in, we gathered for cooking, eating delicious food, and then a lively game of Mafia. It was hilarious watching John get voted out at the beginning before he could even play!

blocks.caption: Taking a well-deserved break after a long hike on the first day of camping... still smiling!

blocks.text: The night continued with laughter and conversation, stretching until 1 or 2 AM. Despite the coyotes roaming the area around the tents (which became surprisingly routine by dawn!), the experience was truly beautiful. We made s'mores, enjoyed campfire treats, and soaked in every moment of true wilderness camping.

blocks.caption: Our second day of hiking! Just a moment of pure relaxation and fun together

blocks.text: The next morning, we set out on another refreshing hike, which was a fantastic opportunity for networking and deeper connections. Getting to know each other amidst nature was truly special.

blocks.caption: By the last day, we're not just a group – we've truly become a Kontagious family!

blocks.text: From the quick one-hour drive from San Jose to our cozy camping spot and back, it was a weekend full of building relationships and strengthening our community. Even with a few minor hiccups, the constant laughter and shared joy made it a memorable time for all. Kontagious camping always delivers an unforgettable experience – we even played Frisbee in the middle of the forest! It was an experience of a lifetime and a great introduction to the American way of loving the wild.

blocks.caption: Airport pick up- Welcome with a Smile on this side of the world

blocks.text: For many international graduate students, the journey to success in the U.S. begins long before they step onto a plane—it begins with a connection to **Kontagious**.

As soon as you register for airport pickup, we reach out to schedule a virtual meeting. This isn't just logistics—it’s our way of saying, “We’re here for you.” We walk you through everything from what to pack and what challenges to expect, to tips for navigating immigration. Especially for students arriving without family, that early connection makes all the difference.

The airport is where your new life truly begins. As you land in the U.S., a smiling Kontagious team member will be there to greet you—often with a small welcome bag filled with water, snacks, and essentials like rice, lentils, tea, and sugar. It’s a simple act, but one that brings comfort and reassurance. Then, we’ll make sure you get safely to your new home. From the very first moment, you’re not navigating this alone.

blocks.caption: Warm welcome in hand, a cool sense of the unfamiliar ahead.

blocks.text: From day one, you’ll be invited into a community that’s been waiting for you. Kontagious hosts welcome dinners, game nights, beach outings, music evenings, hikes, and more. These aren’t just events—they’re intentional spaces to build friendships, ask questions, and find support in a new land.

blocks.caption: The joy of giving back: students volunteers assemble welcome bags

blocks.text: We believe your time in the U.S. should be more than just about earning a degree—it’s a chance to grow personally, professionally, and relationally. Through our events and gatherings, you’ll meet not only fellow students but also local families and professionals who are eager to invest in your journey.

blocks.caption: Welcome dinner! Kontagious Leaders Host the Fun!
Building great connections - Kontagious hospitality at its finest!

blocks.text: Over time, we’ll walk alongside you in other practical areas too—like learning to navigate American culture, getting a driver’s license, or understanding how to build a strong professional network. When you're ready, we’ll help you polish your resume, prep for interviews, and create internships to step into leadership opportunities. You won’t just survive here—you’ll thrive.

blocks.text: At Kontagious, we see every student as a future leader. We offer the community, connections, and resources to support your growth—but the journey begins when you step in with intention.

Imagine: your support can be the key for a student to attend a vital leadership camp, integrate fully, and gain the skills to not just succeed, but to lead. This isn't just charity; it's empowerment. It's planting seeds of leadership for a brighter future.

blocks.caption: John & Carol (Founders)

blocks.text: Kontagious began in 2016 with a simple yet powerful conversation between Bob Thomas, Ken Raasch, and John. They reflected on the immense influence of Silicon Valley and the growing number of Indian professionals moving to the Bay Area—many of whom were struggling to adapt to American life. Moved by this reality, John and Carol felt a deep calling to make a meaningful difference. They believed that investing in this community could ripple outward in powerful ways. That conviction led them to officially launch Kontagious in 2016 with a heart to serve South Asian professionals navigating the complexities of family, parenting, and life in a new cultural landscape.

blocks.caption: A lifetime of memories: Bob Thomas, John Christian and Ken Raasch

blocks.text: In 2017, Kontagious began by creating space for connection through joyful, culturally resonant events like Bollywood dance nights, park yoga, and chai gatherings. But the deeper purpose was still taking shape. Everything changed in 2018 after a pivotal encounter with students at San Jose State University. Relationships with students like Sarang, Mahi, and Neha revealed a crucial insight: university students, especially international grads, were in urgent need of community, guidance, and care. Kontagious found its focus.

blocks.caption: Kontagious: Campus Connection Ignites!
Quarantine Chronicles – Covid-19

blocks.text: Then came the pandemic. As the world shut down, Kontagious stepped up. With love and compassion at its core, the team met students at the airport—over 1500 in three semesters—offering rides, meals, shopping help, and a sense of belonging in the midst of fear and isolation. In that season of crisis, Kontagious became a lifeline, a “family away from home,” and its mission became unmistakably clear.

blocks.caption: Professional help by Sara - Smiles that bridge the gap

blocks.text: Since 2020, Kontagious has grown into thriving student communities at San Jose State and Santa Clara University. Through resume workshops, interview prep, leadership training, retreats, hikes, and cultural events, the organization equips students not only for professional success but for personal growth and meaningful connection. A beautiful full-circle story is now unfolding: the students once served are now leading, mentoring, and giving back to the next wave. Kontagious is building a culture where kindness, belonging, and transformation are contagious.

blocks.text: At its heart, Kontagious is more than an organization—it’s a journey from stranger to family, from uncertainty to purpose, and from being served to serving others.

blocks.caption: Building connections over great food, guided by experienced seniors ready to share their wisdom

blocks.text: In the U.S.—especially as an international student—networking is more than just a buzzword. It’s a lifestyle. It’s one of the most essential keys to professional success and personal growth. That’s why, at Kontagious, we’re passionate about helping students build meaningful connections with business leaders, executives, and professionals right here in the Bay Area.

From the moment you join us, we’re committed to walking with you as you grow—not just as a student, but as a leader. Leadership development is at the heart of what we do. We provide a space where students can discover their potential, take on leadership roles, and build crucial skills like networking, public speaking, interpersonal interaction, and cross-cultural communication.

blocks.caption: Tahoe Leadership Camp -Building a network rooted in friendships and know students from different batches

blocks.text: Our entire student journey is thoughtfully designed to help you adapt to American culture and thrive in it. We start by helping you develop strong communication and interpersonal skills, breaking through language barriers and building confidence. Then, we help bridge the gap between your student experience and the professional world by connecting you with leaders in your field.

blocks.caption: In our leadership camp, personalized mentoring ignites a growing confidence within each student.

blocks.text: Leadership begins from within. At Kontagious, we provide opportunities for students to take on small leadership roles within our programs—roles that offer real experience and personal growth. Whether you’re leading a discussion, helping run a camp, or guiding others, every step is designed to cultivate your leadership potential.

blocks.caption: Mentorship in action: Parag, our chapter leader, gaining insights from seniors on life, internships, and career paths.

blocks.text: Our camps and conferences—like Tahoe! Leadership and Tahoe Live Leadership Camp—are core experiences that offer deep mentorship, leadership training, and community connection. These camps are where we really get to know you, invest in your strengths, and help you find your place as a leader, especially as you adjust to life in a new country.

Beyond our camps, we host workshops throughout the year focused on essential skills like resume writing, interviewing, and professional development. Our Yosemite Camp is another important space where we observe, encourage, and nurture potential leaders—creating space for growth and transformation.

We also offer two to three annual “Rare Leadership” events, inspired by the book Rare Leadership, designed to help you grow in emotional resilience, character, and influence. Alongside these larger events, we hold smaller leadership training sessions and focused discussions—creating consistent moments for growth and development in a nurturing, supportive environment. What makes this journey even more special is our team of volunteers—former students who’ve been where you are. They understand your challenges and opportunities and are dedicated to helping you succeed.

blocks.caption: Capturing the synergy between our SJSU Alumni (Sarang) and Program Lead (Sam)

blocks.text: So if you’re a student joining one of our chapters—welcome. You’re stepping into a life-changing opportunity to grow in leadership, make lasting friendships, and shape your future. If you’re curious about developing your leadership skills as you settle into life in the U.S., we’d love to get to know you. Reach out to our directors or connect with one of our leaders—we’re here to help you thrive.
